target.title: test(cli): add unit tests for CLI argument quoting helper
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `quoteCliArg` function safely quotes CLI arguments when they contain special characters. Without tests, the quoting logic could silently regress.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add unit tests covering safe strings, spaces, single quotes, special characters, and empty strings.

## User Impact

CLI argument quoting now has comprehensive test coverage, reducing regression risk.

## Evidence

Direct behavior probe with real function calls:

```text
$ node --import tsx -e "import('./src/cli/quote-cli-arg.js').then(({quoteCliArg})=>console.log(JSON.stringify([{i:'hello',r:quoteCliArg('hello'),e:'hello'},{i:'hello world',r:quoteCliArg('hello world'),e:'\'hello world\''},{i:"it's",r:quoteCliArg("it's"),e:"'it'\\''s'"}])))"
[{"i":"hello","r":"hello","e":"hello"},{"i":"hello world","r":"'hello world'","e":"'hello world'"},{"i":"it's","r":"'it'\\''s'","e":"'it'\\''s'"}]
```

Targeted test:

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/cli/quote-cli-arg.test.ts

Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  6 passed (6)
  Duration  331ms
```

```text
$ npx oxfmt --check src/cli/quote-cli-arg.ts src/cli/quote-cli-arg.test.ts
Checking formatting...

All matched files use the correct format.
Finished in 87ms on 2 files using 8 threads.
```
